description: This file defines a utility class 'FastMathLiteralArrays' containing tabulated data arrays ('EXP_INT_A' and 'EXP_INT_B') used for fast computation of exponential functions within the 'FastMath' class, part of the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: FastMathLiteralArrays
classes.description: Utility class holding precomputed arrays for fast exponential calculations used by 'FastMath'.

methods.name: loadExpIntA
methods.description: Returns a clone of the EXP_INT_A array containing integer parts of exponential function tabulated data.

methods.name: loadExpIntB
methods.description: Returns a clone of the EXP_INT_B array containing fractional parts of exponential function tabulated data.

methods.name: loadExpFracA
methods.description: Returns a clone of the EXP_FRAC_A array with fractional exponential tabulated values.

methods.name: loadExpFracB
methods.description: Returns a clone of the EXP_FRAC_B array with additional fractional exponential data.

methods.name: loadLnMant
methods.description: Returns a clone of the LN_MANT 2D array containing logarithmic Mantissa values used in computations.
